intro: Between 2026-04-12 and 2026-10-10, ZCyberNews published 66 articles tagged ransomware. LockBit, ShinyHunters, and The Gentlemen feature among the most-covered threat actors. Coverage highlights CVE-2026-1731 (CVSS 9.8), CVE-2026-34197 (CVSS 8.8), CVE-2024-55591, CVE-2025-32433, and CVE-2025-33073. Government, healthcare, manufacturing, multiple, and education rank among the top affected sectors, while the United states, North america, Global, Europe, and Canada appear among the top affected regions. The severity mix across these articles comprises 46 high, 6 critical, 1 medium, and 2 informational items.
